blocks.text: Webhook configuration in the Zscaler Admin Console allows you to deliver alerts for the configured events in the alert rule to third-party applications (e.g., ServiceNow, Splunk) for incident management.
The webhook configuration provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Send event data for incident management.
Associate the webhook to a specific alert rule to receive email notifications when the alert is triggered.

blocks.text: On the Webhooks page (Administration > Alerts > Security & UEBA Alerts > Webhooks), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of all the configured webhooks. For each webhook, you can see the following:
Name: The name of the webhook that is displayed when configuring the alert rule. You can sort this column.
Status: The status of the webhook (Enabled or Disabled).
Modify the table and its columns.
Go to the Alert Rules page.
